title: CEET cognitive profile
description: The ground truth of a pack: every slot of the role's profile template as data. The slots a given role requires are derived from its templates/cognitive-profile.md; validate_pack.py checks them. Verbatim answers are not here: they stay in the pack's private/answers.json.

formVersion.description: The version of the role's form.json the answers were given to; [Q<n>] references resolve against it.

name.description: The person's name or chosen alias; fills the role's name slot.

meta.description: Header values. The renderer fills `date` and `fingerprint_hash` when they are missing.

contradictions.description: Tensions between answers, kept as data (synthesis rule 5). Rendered into `{identity.contradictions}` when that slot has no value of its own.

checks.description: The person's rules that are not judgment calls, as data for ceet_check.py (plan item 2.4). Optional; only what the person stated precisely.

pattern.description: A Python regular expression the first line of a commit message must match.

forbidden.description: Patterns that must not appear in added lines of the files a glob selects.

blocks.description: A line the check must block (its bench case).

passes.description: A line the check must let through (its bench case).

secrets.description: Run the built-in secret scan on commits (no judgment call; on by default when the pack has hooks).

review.description: Decisions the person made while reviewing the synthesis.

specialCategoryCleared.description: Slots whose mention of health, beliefs or another special category the person reviewed and chose to keep, because it is about the work and they want it there.

teachback.description: Whether the person reviewed every directive (plan item 4.3).
